revisions.name: 03-cabinet-closeup-v2

Preserve entire website mockup, radio screenshot, cabinet geometry, joystick, button positions and materials, lighting, tooltip, pointer and bottom UI strip. The physical 2x3 button grid must show EXACTLY these actions: TOP row left is a single left chevron ‹, middle is fullscreen four-corner expand icon, right is single right chevron ›. BOTTOM row repeats left chevron ‹, fullscreen four-corner expand icon, right chevron ›. There must be NO pause, play, camera, photo or info symbols on physical buttons. Bottom right stays illuminated and depressed under the mouse pointer with the exact nearby tooltip "Next screenshot". The UI bar's separate Info icon stays unchanged. No extra labels, text or decorations. Everything except six engraved button-cap icons stays identical. Output full corrected image.
